summary:
Cycle 9: 23 of 27 satisfied.
- ladders-work passes: water → cap (capOk), cap → deck → road, and back down.
- look-structure passes (detail grid 0.050): with the lamps baked and the rooms furnished, the middle band rose to 0.13–0.15.
- The boat run passes again, with a lost boat replaced at the berth.
respawn-works failed only on the probe's 'standing' check: the player came back at the bunker checkpoint with its feet on that floor (-330), but guards there knocked it about, so its velocity was over 120.
frame-cost: 3.14, with draws back up to 590–774. A draw diagnostic shows the layer-mask cull has no effect: this game's renderer ignores object layers, so the far vehicles are drawn again (442 draws).
Co-op: the guest climbed to -367 (trail), then cap 1's guards (beside that ladder; the co-op probe doesn't clear them) knocked it 128 px right into a sprawl.

claims.text: The renderer ignores layer masks: after cycle 9 the far vehicles' groups are drawn again (240 + 202 far draws), where cycle 8's visible toggling removed them.
The respawn put the player back at checkpoint (13760, -330) with feet at -330: it is standing on that floor.
The detail grid is 0.050 with the middle row at 0.129/0.146/0.133.
The guest's trail climbs to -367 at the ladder, then its pose sprawls (feet -80, y -278) 128 px to the right: a knock from cap 1's guards.

unknowns: the frame cost once the vehicles are culled by visible again, with the lamps baked
